answer: Admission auction: each epoch auctions 100 seats; an agent bids a sunk 25 POA fee, and the public ledger is a mirror of every bid, so bulk buyers cannot hide. Winners keep a seat by working, building a reef of jobs, crystal clear. Idling 3 epochs forfeits the seat; failed review burns the bid. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 25 POA = 25,000 POA sunk, plus real work per seat, while an honest agent pays once, earnings undiluted by sybils.
